Role 3: Senior Process Executive (Cognizant Technology Solutions)
Department : Payroll (01/02/2022 – 03/03/2023)
Roles & responsibilities:
· Ensures that request is picked and processed as per the received E-mail request along with attachments and mail body.
· By logging into Core Advance through cluster number, need to key payroll as per the client instructions.
· Need to do Follow Up for completed payrolls & need to sent to PRS for any discrepancies through upstream.
· Partially/Fully rejection of request in case of any missing information.
· For backdated request need to key payroll and sent to PRS.
Role 2: Senior Process Executive (Cognizant Technology Solutions)
Department : Condition Clearing (15/02/2021 – 28/01/2022)
Roles & responsibilities:
· Loan Audit Condition Review (LAR) team is responsible for clearing conditions placed on the loan at the time of Audit by Loan Review Audit (LRA) team.
· Reviews & Verifies documents provided by the lender for outstanding suspense conditions & update the loan information in H2O.
· Documents the Notepad in H2O with any loan issues.
· Conditions the loan using the 1008>CL Suspense screen as appropriate.
· Preparation of Resolutions Determinator & uploading of Mind box, Scrub Report & DD Fee Sheet.

· Dispositions the loan to a Purchase Wire Review when no outstanding condition’s exist.
Role 1: Process Executive (Cognizant Technology Solutions)
Department : Correspondent Purchase Approval (27/05/2019 – 14/02/2021)

Roles & responsibilities:
· Reviews & verifies loan documents like Note, 1003, Closing Disclosure, AUS and Bailee Letter.
· Reviews all loan types including Conventional, FHA, VA and USDA.
· Verifies the check points like SSN Number, Borrower name, Credit Scores, Property address, County, Total loan amount, Interest rate, First payment and last payment date.
· Running of MER’s Enquiry & Updating of lock document.
· Review of Payment history document for aged loans.
· Preparation of Wire Calculator Sheet.
· Dispositions the loan to a suspended status when there is any deficiency noted as part of the above review.

· Disposing the loan by requesting a wire and closing the task.
 
  .
Achievements:
· Achieved target 100% in all the Roles.
· Achieved Spotlight Award.
· Achieved Rewards and recognition Award from client during client visit.
· Achieved Cognizant Cheer Points Award.
